env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd default_cap
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[comptime::ctfe_step_limit\] evaluation exceeds the step limit'
cd ..

cd raised
logos run .
stdout '^raised: 200000$'
cd ..

-- reclib/go.mod --
module example.com/reclib

go 1.27

-- reclib/rec.lgo --
package reclib

// Loop is a pure iterative const function costing about one step per iteration.
const func Loop(n int) int {
	total := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		total += 1
	}
	return total
}

-- default_cap/go.mod --
module example.com/defaultcap

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- default_cap/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"
// Loop(200000) needs about 200,000 steps, past the 100,000 default.
const Exceeded = reclib.Loop(200000)

func main() {
	println(Exceeded)
}

-- raised/go.mod --
module example.com/raised

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- raised/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_ctfe_steps = 1000000

-- raised/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/reclib"
)
// Loop(200000) runs past the default step budget under the raised limit.
const Value = reclib.Loop(200000)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("raised:", Value)
}
